instruction: Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship=roommate); the relationship value is a domain constant so the approve action can require (contacts-searched roommate) and (has-relationship ?p roommate). Payment request ids are discovered by venmo.show_received_payment_requests(status=pending), after which the agent filters by sender email in the roommate emails and created_at within the current calendar month (June 2023, current date 2023-06-24). Only requests that are pending, from a roommate, and from this month can be approved, so no other requests are modified (matching the evaluation: only approved_at changes on exactly the qualifying requests). The number of roommates (3) and qualifying requests (3) are placeholders consistent with the 9-call reference solution; supervisor-complete-task takes the three approved requests as non-API record parameters (pairwise distinct) so its precondition mirrors the goal, and it is forced to be last because every other action requires (not (task-completed)). Approval uses the Venmo balance (no payment_card_id).
